source.coverage: The eight homepage therapeutic areas use their full supplied specialty overviews and all 95 focus items.
editorialNotes: Focus terms retain their source wording; topic groups are editorial navigation aids, not diagnostic classifications or treatment guidance.
The existing homepage card names, order, descriptions, images and focal positions are preserved.
Study considerations retain the existing site copy, presented alongside the supplied specialty content.
Only the eight requested core areas receive pages in this update. No statistics, clinical outcomes, certifications or testimonials have been invented.

hero.headline: Connected expertise for complex oncology research.
hero.description: Study support for evolving therapies and complex clinical endpoints.

overview.title: Scientific depth.
paragraphs: TruMinds supports pharmaceutical, biotechnology, CRO, and healthcare organizations advancing innovative therapies for cancer and hematologic disorders. Our Oncology & Hematology Clinical Research Services span the entire product lifecycle, from early discovery and clinical development through regulatory affairs, medical affairs, biometrics, pharmacovigilance, quality, and commercialization. With expertise in precision medicine, immuno-oncology, cell and gene therapies, and advanced hematologic treatments, we help clients accelerate development programs and bring innovative therapies to patients worldwide.
